shorts_extract.hook: An infant monkey anchors its feet to soft milkless terrycloth while stretching sideways just to sip from a bare wire bottle.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Harlow's 1958 8-subject dual-surrogate timer study (17 hours on cloth vs <2 hours on wire feeder) plus fear and open-field tests.
shorts_extract.twist: How secure bases unlock bravery — and the sobering ethical lesson that real social play requires living peers, not just cloth.
